parsed.rationale: Every one of the 9 members declared on `AudioPlayerProtocol` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/AudioPlayerProtocol.swift`) appears verbatim in `TimeShiftablePlayer` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/TimeShiftablePlayer.swift`). `TimeShiftablePlayer` then adds 6 time-shifting-specific members (`isAtLiveEdge`, `maxLookbackSeconds`, `secondsBehindLive`, `seek:`, `seekToLive:`, `timePositionStream`), making it a strict superset. Both protocols live in the same `Playback` package and neither carries any restraint flags, so the duplication is purely structural and actionable. Declaring `TimeShiftablePlayer: AudioPlayerProtocol` removes all 9 redundant declarations from `TimeShiftablePlayer` and makes the 'is-a' relationship explicit in the type system.
